name: Voter Action Project Voter Registration Team
subject: Increasing participation to fight suppression
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
We're not cowering in the face of voter suppression, and we refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. We're focusing all our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .
Driving voter participation is more critical now than ever. RUSH $30 or more today and help register new and lapsed voters across the country >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062326_3&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
How did Americans across the country, especially in the South, respond to the Supreme Court's decision to legally codify racial gerrymandering? They turned out in droves to march for their fundamental right to vote, folks.
For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Every $3 chipped in can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, please pitch in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062326_3&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=062326_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=062326_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=062326_3&amount=50]

This Supreme Court decision was a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve. If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote.
Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This voter registration work, at just about $3 per new voter, is how we can make the greatest impact. Fuel our efforts with $30 to give us the resources we need to register new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062326_3&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=062326_3&amount=20]

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. clean_body: I really hate to bother you | = I emailed you on Saturday. I emailed you again on Sunday. I even sent you a text on Monday! Now, I’m emailing you again today. I really hate to bother you (I know how busy life can get!), but this couldn’t wait – = | | = I can’t overstate just how important this end-of-quarter goal is to Democrats’ chances of retaking the Senate. Mary Peltola, Jon Ossoff, Sherrod Brown, and James Talarico are counting on the support of countless grassroots Democrats like you. = I cannot make phone calls to each of these Democrats to let them know we’ve missed our goal – not just because I don’t want to, but because we simply cannot afford to. Experts are reporting that Democrats have a 50/50 chance of retaking the Senate this fall! Reaching our goal would swing those odds in our favor, but missing our goal? We can all but kiss the Senate goodbye. | | Dear Peter,
The clock is ticking. We are just SIX WEEKS away from the primary election for Washington's Ninth Congressional District.
As I’m sure you know, only the **top two** candidates will move on to the general election.
**In order to be able to get out the vote for Kshama’s independent socialist campaign, we need to raise $20,000 dollars in this final week of June to pay for thousands of posters and yard signs to paint the district red over the coming weeks.**
---
|
---
| | All these campaign materials cost money. Each yard sign and wire stake to put it in the ground costs $8. We need to put them up in Seattle, Renton, Tukwila, Bellevue, Kent, SeaTac, Auburn, Federal Way and everywhere else in the district. We have incredible support for our campaign and already have eight and a half times as many donors in the district as Adam Smith, but Smith has a median donation of $1,000 and the billionaires, the Zionist lobby, and the war industry behind him. We need your support!
---
| | [**Can you donate $25, $100, or $500 now?**](https://us.list-manage.com/19aAgdIFcUy?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| | Kshama is the only candidate in this race fighting for free healthcare for all by taxing the rich; to end all military aid to Israel; to shut down ICE and the detention centers; to stop the data centers and AI layoffs; and for national rent control.
---
|
---
| | We know from our conversations with tens of thousands of people while canvassing across this district that there is enormous support for all these demands. But most working people don’t vote in primaries. That’s because in the vast majority of elections, there is no candidate running who actually represents working people, and because both parties are owned by the billionaire class.
**We need to do everything possible to make sure the hundreds of thousands of working people in our district know that Kshama and this campaign are** _**fundamentally different**_**** from**everything else on** offer in this**primary election.** We need them to know about the demands our campaign is fighting for. We need them to know about Kshama’s track record of defeating the billionaires to win historic victories like the highest minimum wage in the country, the Amazon Tax, and unprecedented renters rights.
A “Get Out the Vote” campaign, or GOTV, is how we organize to get people to send in their ballots and get involved in our campaign. Volunteers have started collecting “Voter Pledge Cards” from people at our campaign tables. These pledge cards help us organize the vote for Kshama, and allow us to get back in touch with people who sign them after the ballots are mailed. We also are able to turn those who sign the pledge card into organizers themselves by asking them to reach out to three people they think will be supportive, and following up to make sure they vote.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | The corporate media doesn’t want to talk about our independent socialist campaign, because they and the billionaire class they serve are threatened by the prospect of a Kshama Sawant victory. We’ve been fighting back by postering all over the district.
---
| | **We put up 1,400 posters in just FOUR days last week!****Our campaign is all across the district!**
---
| | You may have seen bright red campaign posters with our demands in places like the Central District, Othello, Tukwila, SeaTac, Renton, and more already. We will be putting up tens of thousands of them between now and election day.
---
|
---
| | There hasn’t been a more important moment for an independent socialist campaign like this in most of our lifetimes. Both Democrats and Republicans are at record low approval ratings, and support for a general strike, for unions, and for a new party for working people are at record highs. But these things won’t happen on their own, we need to build movements that are capable of winning fundamental change. Electing a proven, relentless fighter like Kshama to Congress would be transformative for the working class around this country. **Kshama has pledged that if she’s elected, she will use her Congressional office to build mass movements in the same way she did on the Seattle City Council.**
Donate today, and get involved. We need your help putting up posters, talking to working people about our campaign, helping voters fill out pledge cards, phonebanking people to remind them to vote, and putting up yard signs all over the district. Sign up to volunteer today!
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
**Derek, I’m sorry to email again. But I have to say it: Donald Trump’s speech in Pennsylvania today was complete and total BS.** He went on and on and on about his personal vendettas. He made claims that have no basis in reality. And worst of all? He actually believes he’s built an “A-plus-plus-plus-plus-plus” economy for Pennsylvanians. (Seriously, those are his words.) Let’s be real: most Pennsylvanians aren’t feeling “A-plus-plus-plus-plus-plus” about Donald Trump’s disastrous economic agenda that’s screwed over hardworking Pennsylvanians... except my far-right opponent. As I type this email, her campaign is bringing in cash because of Trump’s speech in PA. [_**Derek, I’m not my MAGA opponent. name: Jeff Walter for Congress
subject: Illinois Deserves Better Than an Out-of-Touch Millionaire
body:
There is one thing we can all agree on: People representing hardworking families in Washington should understand the challenges families face.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/kZ1E4cETidX?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends,
There is one thing we can all agree on: _**People representing hardworking families in Washington should understand the challenges families face.**_
Families across Illinois' 11th District are working hard, playing by the rules, and trying to build a better future. Yet many in Washington are making life harder, not easier.
_**That's why it's so frustrating that Illinois' 11th District is represented by an out-of-touch millionaire instead of a leader who puts hardworking families first.**_
Bill Foster is one of the wealthiest members of Congress and claims to represent hardworking Illinois families, but his record tells a different story. Time and again, Foster has supported higher taxes, more government spending, and the same failed Washington policies that put more pressure on family budgets and small businesses instead of relieving them.
While families are looking for relief, Bill Foster continues to support a tax-and-spend agenda that grows government instead of helping the people he was elected to serve.
That's the difference between an out-of-touch millionaire focused on Washington politics and a leader focused on the people back home.
_**Jeff Walter is different.**_
_**Jeff is a Navy veteran, businessman, husband, father, and the Mayor of Elburn. He understands the challenges facing ordinary families because he lives them every day.**_
While Bill Foster represents the out-of-touch political class, Jeff Walter represents the hardworking men and women who keep our communities running and deserve real representation.
Now we need your help.
_**June 30 is our deadline**_. The numbers we report that night will determine whether national organizations, party leaders, and major supporters view this campaign as a serious opportunity to flip Illinois' 11th Congressional District.
Our goal is to raise $25,000 before midnight on June 30 and show that this campaign has the momentum, grassroots support, and resources necessary to win.
Every dollar sends a message that _**the people of this district are ready to replace an out-of-touch millionaire with a Navy veteran, businessman, and mayor who understands their lives and will fight for them.**_
_**Can you chip in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford today?**_
Together, we can send Jeff Walter to Washington and finally give Illinois' 11th District the leadership it deserves.
Thank you,Team Walter

---

---
In the final hours of this year's legislative session, Arizona Republicans walked away from a real compromise on ESA voucher accountability. Instead, they pushed through three ballot referrals that voters will see this November — a package designed to punish educators, mislead parents, and protect the unaccountable voucher program from any future reform.
Here's what they're sending you:
1\. **An attack on teachers' freedom to organize.** This measure would bar teachers and school employees from using normal workplace tools — even something as basic as email — to communicate about or participate in union activity, and would make striking a fireable offense. It's designed to weaken educators' collective voice and make it harder for them to advocate for students, fair pay, and safe schools.
2.**A "60% rule" that sounds good and isn't.** This measure would require many districts to spend 60% of their budgets on "direct instructional costs" — but it ignores how schools actually work. Transportation, special education services, counseling, school safety, and building maintenance all directly support students too. A rigid mandate like this risks punishing districts for the very costs that keep classrooms running, without sending a single new dollar to Arizona schools.
3\. **A "military families" measure that's really about something else**. Republicans are branding this one as protection for military families' college savings. But buried in the language is a broader provision that would block future efforts to reform the ESA voucher program — even if voters approve those reforms separately. It's a trap, not a protection.
None of this fixes Arizona's real school funding problems. None of it came after Republicans tried — and failed — to reach a real deal with educators. It came after that deal fell apart, in its place.
The Arizona Democratic Party is working to elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will defend and fight for Arizona values. Early voting ahead of the July 21 primary starts tomorrow. That's the whole point of this campaign: **hometowns over headlines.** While other candidates spend their summer doing TV hits in studios, I'm out in the grass (literally) meeting people like the gentleman in this photo, a veteran, who took the time to talk about what matters to him and his community.

Fellow American,I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you. Your unwavering support means the world to me.
Because of your dedication, I can keep fighting for our shared values in the Senate. Whether it is advocating for sensible economic policies, defending our national security, or ensuring Maine's interests are always front and center, your backing gives me the strength to do what is right for our state and our country.
We have important work ahead of us. There are critical issues facing our communities, and we must remain focused on delivering real results. Knowing I have you in my corner gives me absolute confidence that we can tackle these challenges head-on.
I have written a special, short note just for you to express my gratitude and outline our next steps.

clean_body: WFP's Brad Lander just defeated Democratic incumbent Dan Goldman in his primary in NY-10! | | | Quick update, Peter: WFP’s Brad Lander just defeated Democratic incumbent Dan Goldman in his primary for New York’s 10th Congressional District. **Voters in every corner of the district responded to a campaign rooted in the struggles millions of people know all too well: paychecks that don't stretch as far as they used to, rents that keep going up, and the feeling that no matter how hard you work, it's getting harder to get ahead. And New Yorkers aren't alone. The same story is playing out across the country. Voters have been rejecting the idea that a handful of wealthy corporations should have more power than millions of ordinary people. And they're choosing leaders like Brad who are willing to fight back. That's why Working Families Party champions have been winning races across the country. But we're not done yet. While we celebrate tonight, organizers are already hard at work preparing for critical congressional primaries in Colorado, Michigan, and other key races still ahead of us. It can be easy to feel cynical about politics right now, Peter. Every day, working families are asked to pay more for groceries, rent, childcare, and healthcare while billionaires and corporations tighten their grip on our economy and our politics. But nights like this remind us that another future is possible. Brad's win is the latest in a string of victories for Working Families Party champions running for Congress across the country. Voters are rejecting a politics that says working people should settle for less while billionaires get more. They're choosing leaders who understand what it means to struggle with rising costs, impossible rents, crushing medical bills, and the fear that the next generation may be worse off than the last. Now we need to keep going. If you want to see more Working Families Party champions like Brad Lander , Analilia Mejia , Chris Rabb , Bob Brooks , Randy Villegas , and Mai Vang in Congress, we're asking you to invest in this movement today: In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? My Colorado 2026 Radio Interview Counter-Arguments: Debunking RCV 1\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Increases Voter Participation and Turnout" The Reality of Turnout Collapse: In Alaska’s 2022 cycle, the general election, the state's first under RCV, collapsed to a mere 44.3% turnout, marking one of the lowest general election turnouts in the state's history. The complexity of the system acts as a de facto barrier to entry. The "Exhausted" Ballot and Manufactured Majorities: RCV creates "Ballot Exhaustion" through undervotes, overvotes, and duplicate rankings. When these ballots are discarded mid-tabulation, it creates a "Manufactured Majority", a winner who claims 50% of remaining active ballots, but lacks a true majority of the total votes cast by the citizens who showed up. 2\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Reduces Negative Campaigning and Fosters Unity" Increased Negativity and Conflict: An MIT study shows that RCV can actually increase negative campaigning. Strategic Bullet Voting: In Alaska's 2022 races, intense "vote-splitting" and conflict between candidates (like Sarah Palin and Nick Begich) discouraged ranking altogether, forcing voters to resort to "Strategic Bullet Voting", where they refuse to rank anyone else to avoid harming their top choice. 3\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Eliminates Extremism and Moderates Outcomes" The Non-Monotonicity Trap: RCV suffers from a mathematical pathology called "non-monotonicity." This is a strategic trap where ranking a candidate higher can actually cause them to lose. Gaming the System: This pathology forces voters to gamble on polling data and manipulate their rankings rather than voting their true conscience, creating a total illusion of true consensus. 4\. Countering the Claim: "RCV Empowers Swing, Unaffiliated, and Third-Party Voters" The Collapse of Third Parties: The "jungle primary" acts as a functional gatekeeper. Instead of helping third parties, third-party representation in Alaska completely collapsed under RCV, dropping from five candidates in 2020 to zero in 2022. Socioeconomic Stratification: RCV functions as an elitist system that rewards the highly educated while marginalizing vulnerable populations. A University of Pennsylvania study of 3.09 million ballots showed: The Wealth Gap: In Oakland, CA, error rates in poor minority communities reached as high as 25% (1 in 4 ballots), compared to just 1 in 15 in rich white communities. Rural Disenfranchisement: In Alaska, 1 in 8 rural Alaskan Natives suffered premature ballot exhaustion. Elderly Withdrawal: For older voters, the psychological burden of having to "keep learning" a new system leads to total withdrawal from the democratic process. 5\. Countering the Claim: "RCV is a Necessary Change and Modern Upgrade" Staggering Taxpayer Costs: It is not a neutral upgrade; it is a fiscal burden. In Alaska, the average election cost surged 328%, ballooning from $3.3 million to $11.1 million. Voter education costs alone experienced a 2,000% explosion, jumping from $150,000 to $3.1 million just to mitigate ballot errors. Vendor and Software Dependency: The system locks states into heavy vendor dependencies, including $4 million every five years for Dominion software upgrades and a $75,000 annual access fee for RCV-specific software tabulations. The National Rejection: There is a growing national consensus against this system. A long list of states have already moved to ban or reject RCV, including Florida, Tennessee, South Dakota, Idaho, Montana, Arizona, and many others. Summary Table for Quick Reference Proponent Claim The Forensic Reality Increases Turnout Alaska 2022 saw record-low general turnout (44.3%). Ends Negative Campaigning MIT studies show increased intra-party conflict and negativity. Empowers Third Parties Third-party candidates in Alaska dropped from 5 to 0. Simplicity & Fairness Caused a 2,000% voter education budget spike; 25% error rate in minority zones. Majority Rule Uses "Manufactured Majorities" by discarding thousands of exhausted ballots.

It’s Cait Conley. I am humbled and honored to write to you for the first time as the Democratic nominee for Congress in NY-17. Thank you to the voters of New York’s 17th district who trusted me with their vote. And to everyone who voted for another candidate, I look forward to earning your support in this movement for a better Hudson Valley. **We are united now by something much bigger than any one campaign: the fight to defeat Mike Lawler, take back the House, and deliver for the working families of the Hudson Valley.** My entire career, I have stepped up to solve some of the toughest problems facing our country and delivered results when it mattered most. I spent 16 years in the Army, deployed six times overseas to keep our families safe. I’ve gone from the battlefield to the Situation Room when the stakes were life and death, and I sure as hell am not afraid of a lifelong political hack like Mike Lawler. Mike Lawler has had four years to fight for this district. But instead, he has fought for his political career and rubberstamped a MAGA agenda that gutted our healthcare, jacked up our costs, and undermined our democracy and our freedoms. I didn't serve this country to watch it get sold out by a career politician who would rather protect his party than his constituents. The people of the Hudson Valley deserve better. They deserve a representative who fights for the veteran trying to get the benefits they earned, the senior trying to afford a prescription, the parent trying to keep up with grocery bills, the immigrant family searching for a brighter future, the small-business owner trying to make payroll, and the young person wondering whether they can afford to build a life here. Tonight, we celebrate. Tomorrow, we will get to work. [**If you can afford to help us fund that work, I’m humbly asking for you to make a donation right now. **About Cait**
When I first met Cait Conley, one thing immediately stood out: she has spent her life answering the call to serve.
Like me, Cait is a Hudson Valley native and West Point graduate. She served our country in uniform and went on to take on some of the toughest national security assignments our government has to offer. Throughout her career, she has put mission before self and country before politics.
That's exactly the kind of leadership we need more of right now.
And it's why I'm proud to support Cait's campaign for Congress in New York's 17th District.
**NY-17: A true toss-up we need to win**
New York's 17th Congressional District is one of the most competitive and important battlegrounds in the country.
Stretching across the lower Hudson Valley, NY-17 is the kind of district that will help decide not only control of the House, but the direction of the country. Voters here are looking for leaders who can rise above the noise, focus on results, and put service ahead of politics.
It’s one of just a handful of districts in the country which voted for Kamala Harris yet elected a Republican representative. It’s a prime pickup opportunity.
That's why this race matters so much. At a moment when trust in government is low and too many politicians are focused on themselves, NY-17 has the opportunity to send a different kind of leader to Washington.

As a fellow West Point graduate, Army veteran, and Hudson Valley native, I know firsthand the character, discipline, and commitment that public service requires.
I've seen Cait's dedication to our country up close. Like me, she's devoted her life to serving something larger than herself. She understands the responsibility that comes with leadership and the importance of delivering real results. This fight will be tough, and I know she can win it.
I'm proud to endorse Cait because she represents the next generation of patriotic, service-driven leadership our country needs. She has spent her career answering the call when our nation needed her most, and I know she'll bring that same sense of duty, integrity, and purpose to Congress.

My support for Cait is also part of a larger mission.
I started Patriot PAC because I believe our country needs a new generation of leaders rooted in service, patriotism, and community. Veterans. Public servants. Teachers. First responders. People who have spent their lives serving our country.
The path forward for Democrats isn't about fitting into one ideological box. It's about putting forward leaders who understand sacrifice, know how to solve problems, and are willing to fight for us.
She has spent her life serving our country, and she embodies exactly the kind of leadership I want Patriot PAC to help elect across New York and across America.
Together, we're building a patriotic majority.

## Trump and Iran Clash over Nuclear Deal
President Trump and Iran are openly [clashing over](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuhDAQBNCvMZ0RGGND4SIN3aVNiQysjz0tGNnLocvXRxflD1KPNKM3X7fx5pFwv3_6DRyHOO5wZQJmSON-zgQ-JfAzx0TR7_kBRK8wqkoZWRmp9Lh4pNeoi8UFAAVNAa62nVJ9a7u-WF03tV1o-s4GvbRBtwEghH5uwQSvJxsKdO-2yihdV1WvbdnbVk91XevGWDC-FrqCBTmm8hFx5xUCveITUjnHrSC3Mh9ZNB9CDUIN13WV85Tfincu1ED4BHkei2fIQg2Y_C7PLC-fJKdzO-QfU2ZkyDJz8sgyBrnGtJ3fQg1FcstxIRFmY4Wu7ptH-l3nf132dOonAAD___Mvgr0) whether Tehran agreed to international nuclear inspections, a flashpoint in the fragile deal meant to end their four-month war. Iran's foreign ministry said there are [no plans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ8GOiN7MQYKF39Dl7-9Ei1mSRwtNrKdoLz9idO9wZUzI43mm6_bfEPPPtz_4062bHEOdGamUijN4eWYMCVCV2LiiCE_ifmzzSDBCGkE6HlFz59Z16vdiIDamqzqB4Cx64exftjFdGA6dAO0etv0sAAtsBppSKnRmKH29mqTBrSSctR9M_adXpRSujU9GVSVlrT6ElPzjD6UB238iW9KjYt7zfZRypGr9l8FUwXTeZ5NWNxFceWXExOvFUw-YahgKum1H-IS4sQkfhmFD_kgV3wMWfickFgwLRhiEB4JxRuDI5FcwLZTbdvVya7H6Zl9Nn2l5X1Hzz-Lyp9ufFv4DgAA___H64gC) to let inspectors examine its bombed nuclear sites, contradicting Vice President JD Vance, while Trump insisted Tehran "fully" agreed. Meanwhile, a United Nations maritime agency launched a plan to [evacuate more than 11,000](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuhDAQBNCvMZ2RWXw2FC7S0F3alGiB5fDF2Mgshy5fH5FfSDPNSG-k-br3d_TBx8cnruR4Tn2kcw_ETLmPxxgIcyYcOeWQMO5PCuE996DASGUk6H5CH969LiY3EwHVBbnKNgDtzTZtsTgcbNM2yoAZqAatm1tNWA-TNWacKrKFd5emDOhKqVbbsrU3PVRVpWtjyWAltKLJc8rlM_nIC83hnV6UyzGtRXAL87aL-kNAJ6A7z7Mc4zBepYDuogV06gqoBXQ7Z_Qsl5TX40dulHePUT6OMMt98ZtkjN-UJb1wPJB9iuXCayiym7bTh-B3Y4VWjxV9-Nvnf532cvAbAAD__2KVgEI) seafarers stranded in the Persian Gulf, as traffic through the Strait of Hormuz slowly returns. At home, the Senate [voted 50-48 to rebuke](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAYBOCngc0RYAxmYOjiLV07Wtg-x0S_IcI0Vt6-Soe-QOc7fdLd13W8hkgx3T7DDl_XPCacB6FWlDF9z4RQCsJcc6Ec0nEH0WsdlVCmEaZRelxCpNeo-eJXQKHl8NL2SrnO9o5vvp-0w4rQOUyzduhlKyS6GQsmuy6WR__WhFFaCuG0vTjb6UlKqVtjYYJkWmCJNZfLPcdUN6z0yk-Uy5x3Tn6r9XGw9oOpgamhbtgi0TtjatjyjvcgpoYDKVQwNXSuNaYTTSwhNWcozSOfKEfzV-DFL48zEsXDWKbFbQ_xF-T1Xw89vfoJAAD__4u4eoI) Trump over the war, with four Republicans joining Democrats to direct him to withdraw U.S. forces, though the measure is symbolic.
## US to Loan $17.5B for 10 Nuclear Reactors
The Energy Department announced Tuesday that it will [loan $17.5 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAMhp8mbEGJCUkZMtzC1ltvRAFMSWWSKrhFffsTp77BLR5s69P_fz_X4RoixXT7Dht6XvKQ8NgJmbEM6TkRhlIwTJwL5ZD2OxK9lwEUWKmsBDPMIdJ7MNXsF0TApkKv3QWga92lq1YPWi8NhM6G0GLngu4mrdvlosHatlVTFf1JUxaMVqozru5ca0attWmsQxu0MArnyLnU9xwTr7jQO7-w1FPeKvIr82MXzZeAXkB_HEc9pXE6jwL6Ey2gV-eARkDP5bk9ZJi3mOLOJXDMSXKWZzupnRwj0Wc1PiPNUiv58SA_IvZ65Y2q4ufHcX7v1gmjbluI9BeJ_-Xx5eE3AAD__0Uqhd4) to fast-track 10 large nuclear reactors, betting on surging electricity demand from the data centers powering artificial intelligence. The money would back five projects, each building two reactors using Westinghouse's AP1000 design, and marks one of the [largest efforts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLESnCAURb8GOxx4sqgFRRq7TZvSQXno20FwkF3j32dM9g_S3jlz597z6zk-LQWKy0-7oSk-jRHPI2ApmMf4ngPanNHOJeWQbDxeGMLlRxCgudAc1OgshWtUlTMeEbCp0Mi2A-gfbddXqxHd5KfJa9l5p3o_q05Y59xkhX7MIJuKzN0mNCgpRK_aum8fapJSqka3qK1kSqCjknL9ShTLij5c6YO5ntNWBbOWsh-s-cFgYDCc51mf9lgpLiVF_G03iv9QBsOeAs0Xg0FpEKoRDIaS39vOrdso0lGyLZQiv69SXLhs-UQh3NH0puC4FDzYvCD_quFfNweDocrG7eeNH7plSiybpfB3Y_kvsR8DfwIAAP__hQqPAw) by the agency's revamped financing office, which earlier this year canceled nearly $30 billion in clean energy loans approved under former President Biden. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the financing [would drive down costs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O4yAUxfGngc4RXL5CQbGNu2y7pUXMdUx0DRZmE_ntRxnNG0x9pJ90_v9u0y1myuXxN24Y-lKngu-DsHdsU_k_E8bWMM69NqqxHE8kOpcJBNhB2AH0lGKmc9I8hQURUHEM0l0BvHFXz9dglEHvvUnz3SrpvbTJACSLXi-LEo7n8NGEBS2F8NpdvDP6LqXUyjq0UTItMOVe2-VZc-krLnTWF7bLXDdOYe19P5j6w2BkMPYV10z02RiMe6U8nwxGLNge54DllVstG5bOYDReWZB--Pk57PWNbdgpln4wGHkLaX9nonxYx7R4bDF_w7z_qtQrwFcAAAD__0kPfIo) and could speed deployment by up to 3 years, calling the risk to taxpayers very low. Officials hope construction begins by 2030, with the reactors coming [online in the mid-2030s](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO6yAYhE-DOyLAGExB8V7hLttssaX1B34nRBgiwLF8-5VzhW1nRqP55uc6XyHEkO5fsKJtS54T7jVia1jmtLmIUAqCa7nEDKk-McZjmQUTijJFhZw9hHjMsvN2QRTYd2i5HoUwgx5N97DcLR4VG9C5ngEw6Y1R2puRIzc9yC7Ys40pITljRuqL0YO8cc5lrzQq4EQy9KHlcnnmkNoDl3jkN5aLy2sX7aO1VyX9PyImIia4uZPg9IiY_m81JKyViGkPBb9bLgcRUyvb-qLg15BCbQVayIlCSnlLDivleqC3EOOpfqgpZzThTnkvea9Hwbti_Ws_I1VpItl9hRA_e9qfTnxb8RsAAP__0keGfA).
## Pilot Describes Iran Jellyfish Drones
Newly surfaced details from an April incident reveal a U.S. fighter pilot shot down over Iran told debriefers he saw Iranian drones hovering and moving as one, in a formation that [resembled a jellyfish](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQRp8GOiM8mL_CxW3octstkYOHMNnBg2wnKG-_yq72CbY_Op--83GZL46Ywu2_29HmVeaAZ2LMGeMcHgujixHdkiWyuJDuyPxaZ6ihU3WnwMzeEb9mU3q7IgI2JVrdDwBj2w9juVnv2mH0ulkH0OgAFhx6NwzeQAtd215Lsm9b3YHRdT2avhr71ly11qbpeuycLkyNnrLE6i4U8oYrv-SJsVpkL9luOR-paP4VMBUwnedZZdoxyUopOuQ3VcD0SOoglqy8nAG9egsURRdUxENiRq8SIoWb-rlIaVNMn6h8lIBqlbi7TPKLFzCV0frjJGZKXV-Y-rY7-l4r859CPi18BQAA__8SlIrV). The airman, downed in enemy territory before his rescue, described a ["minefield of drones"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZD0yxgND4OASsr30QtTY7cGrHnvU9i7i70_cfcImlZT0VPX-fKwfmDjl5298kWuxrJmOytQayZq_PBOKEPpWhAvm-knMZ1yNNiPoEYxdAyY-V9sFF4kMDR25fnoYM9-nx9ztbttivGv_iHc728H3HtFa6x-oSYeRxi65i6ZHY3utZzvd5ulut77v7TBONGKvrKaQWpHbZ0m57RT5LN8kN19eHbu9tXdVwy9lFmWWfL5LbVelzHKBlVn0FWZQZjmKcIDrojLLV4WYnnsjgXfi0qDupUEoR4bthCSYIVD1kjaqgIzySvkJ_w2kukOQkqnCRrEIgResOwghA3KiDBWaMksnLryPxJzqOCmrny9M_G95-5Hub2f-BgAA__-4EpW8) overhead, comparing the sight to something out of an alien encounter. One [drone expert said](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb8GO3bgibIWFGnsNm1KB_GpbwfBAXaNf58x-YQ0t7kzZ-65X4_hYclTWD7thqbMcQh4ZI-lYBrCy3m0KaF1JSYfbchP9P6cBxDQctFyUMNkyZ-DqiYzIwLWFRqp7wBdo-9dtRphUY2NVFqMo7x3iNZ1TjvXuHnSnYaKzEUTLSgpRKf0rdONGqWUqm41tlYyJXCiEtPtGSmUFWd_xjemm4tb5c1ayp5Z_cGgZ9CHc4-5XBWD_gIz6MUVUDPoj5j8xC9FBj0lGzL_M6K88inFgJmvFErmCRfakFPmI-JMYeGvnR828YJu5fi9YyoM-iqZaT_Ie8qtZkosmyX_O6z86823gZ8AAAD__wF4iYE) Iran may have used a "mothership" that flies high, then drops smaller attack drones, and warned that Tehran is adapting its war technology faster than the U.S. It marked the first time Iran shot down a U.S. jet over its own soil during the war, and intelligence analysts remain divided over what the concussed pilot actually saw.
